title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of five lines. The first line starts at coordinates (0.0, 0.0437) and ends at (0.0437, 0.0). The second line runs from (0.0437, 0.0) to (0.0874, 0.0437). The third line extends from (0.0874, 0.0437) to (0.0874, 0.75). The fourth line goes from (0.0874, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75), and the fifth line completes the loop by connecting (0.0, 0.75) back to (0.0, 0.0437). Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire first sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space using the same Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0221 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism with rounded edges are a length of 0.08740020095727861, a width of 0.7500000223516924, and a height of 0.022071872558532907.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0437) \
     .lineTo(0.0437, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0874, 0.0437) \
     .lineTo(0.0874, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.75) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0437) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0221)

import cadquery as cq

# Long flat bar with a pointed (chisel) tip in plan view
# Overall bounding box: X 0.0874, Y 0.7500, Z 0.0221

L = 0.7500     # length along Y
W = 0.0874     # width along X
T = 0.0221     # thickness along Z
taper = 0.0650 # length of the pointed taper

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(W, 0.0)
    .lineTo(W, L - taper)
    .lineTo(W / 2.0, L)
    .lineTo(0.0, L - taper)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions from the bounding box
w = 0.0874      # width along X
L = 0.7500      # length along Y
t = 0.0221      # thickness along Z
tip = w / 2.0   # symmetric 45 deg point at the far Y end

# Plan (top-view) profile: rectangle with a centered V point
pts = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (w, 0.0),
    (w, L - tip),
    (w / 2.0, L),
    (0.0, L - tip),
]

r = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline(pts).close().extrude(t)
